name: Jesse
title: David's father
summary: Jesse (also called Isai) was the son of Obed and grandson of Boaz and Ruth. He was the father of King David and lived in Bethlehem. Jesse plays an important role in God's plan of salvation as an ancestor in the messianic lineage.

keyEvents.title: Jesus in the Line of David
keyEvents.description: Jesus is mentioned as the son of Obed and father of David in the genealogy, linking him to Boaz and Ruth and the messianic line.

keyEvents.title: Samuel Sent to Jesse
keyEvents.description: God sent the prophet Samuel to Jesse in Bethlehem to anoint one of his sons as king over Israel, after Saul had been rejected.

keyEvents.title: Jesse Presents His Sons to Samuel
keyEvents.description: Jesse had his sons pass before Samuel one by one, but the Lord rejected them all until the youngest, David, was brought from the sheep flock.

keyEvents.title: Jesse Sends David to Saul
keyEvents.description: When Saul was troubled by an evil spirit, Jesse sent his son David with gifts to the king, and David became Saul's armor-bearer and played the harp for him.

keyEvents.title: Jesse Sends David to His Brothers at the Battlefield
keyEvents.description: Jesse sent David with food to his older sons who were serving in Saul's army, which led to David's confrontation with Goliath.

keyEvents.title: The Root of Jesse – Messianic Prophecy
keyEvents.description: The prophet Isaiah prophesied about a branch that shall spring up from the stump of Jesse, a messianic prophecy pointing to Jesus Christ who will come from Jesse's lineage.
